title: Stale in-progress task should be archived or properly re-opened
description: The trellis task `00-bootstrap-guidelines` is in the active task list as `in_progress` but the underlying work (filling `.trellis/spec/`) has actually shipped. Either (a) mark the task as `completed`, set `completedAt` to today, and run `python3 .trellis/scripts/task.py archive 00-bootstrap-guidelines` so the task moves to `archive/2026-06/`, OR (b) if the work is NOT actually done, restart the task and re-do the spec fill. Verify after: `python3 .trellis/scripts/task.py list` should not include `00-bootstrap-guidelines` as active, and `python3 .trellis/scripts/task.py list-archive 2026-06` should include it.
acceptance_criteria: Active task list no longer contains 00-bootstrap-guidelines as in_progress
Spec content under .trellis/spec/ has zero (To be filled by the team) placeholders

argv: import subprocess; result = subprocess.run(['python3', '.trellis/scripts/task.py', 'list'], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True); assert '00-bootstrap-guidelines' not in result.stdout
pinned_qa_commands.description: Active task list does not contain the bootstrap task

argv: import subprocess; result = subprocess.run(['python3', '.trellis/scripts/task.py', 'list-archive', '2026-06'], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True); assert '00-bootstrap-guidelines' in result.stdout
pinned_qa_commands.description: Archive list contains the bootstrap task

argv: from pathlib import Path; matches = [str(path) for path in Path('.trellis/spec').rglob('*') if path.is_file() and 'To be filled' in path.read_text()]; assert not matches, matches
